title: Kelvin API Success Envelope
description: Standard success envelope for every 2xx JSON response from the Kelvin control plane. Failures NEVER use this envelope; they use RFC 7807 Problem Details (api-error.schema.json). 204 No Content responses carry no body. Normative reference: docs/api/API_STANDARDS.md §6.

success.description: Literal true. A false value in this position is a contract violation; errors belong in Problem Details.

data.description: Primary payload: an object (single resource or mutation result), an array (one cursor-paginated collection page), or null (e.g. 204-adjacent acknowledgements with no resource).

oneOf.description: One page of a collection. Unpaginated (endless) arrays are banned.

meta.description: Request-scoped metadata. REQUIRED for collection responses; optional otherwise. Carries pagination state only.

count.description: Number of items in this page (len of data array).

next_cursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor for the next page. Null or absent on the final page. Clients MUST NOT parse or construct cursors.

has_more.description: True when at least one further page exists.

total.description: Exact total result count, emitted ONLY where cheaply available (e.g. admin views). Never a COUNT(*) over unbounded tenant tables.
